title: Klippo Category-Specific Video Prompt Library
usage_notes: Prompt generation is text-only. No uploaded image or AI image analysis is used; infer bag/wallet subtype from the product name.
No product image is required for prompt generation. Infer the likely product subtype from the product name; ask the user to correct the category if ambiguous.
These are reusable, fixed prompt templates; do not randomly rewrite them at runtime.
This file only adds a prompt library; it does not change video generation, menus, storage, billing, or deployment.
Prompts are for external image-to-video tools such as Gemini; Klippo's existing FFmpeg slideshow renderer does not animate the product as generative video.
Additional category templates are reusable prompts. Review category fit and product-lock behavior with sample products before production use.

prompts.label: Walking OOTD
prompts.description: Model berjalan secara semula jadi untuk menunjukkan keseluruhan pakaian dan jatuhan kain.
prompts.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 product advertisement for the product name supplied by the user, in the Pakaian category. Creative direction: Model berjalan secara semula jadi untuk menunjukkan keseluruhan pakaian dan jatuhan kain. Keep the named product as the clear hero. Use plausible generic visuals and natural camera movement. This prompt is generated from text only; no uploaded image or AI image analysis is used. Do not invent exact materials, specifications, features, compartments, included accessories, product benefits, brand marks or labels that are not stated in the product name. STRICT OUTPUT RULES: exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16, one cohesive product video, no on-screen text, no captions, no added logos, no watermark, no morphing, no floating objects, no unrealistic transformations. Keep the product presentation consistent and finish with a clean hero frame.
